name: Garuda
description: Legend has it that there is a bird named Golden-winged Dapeng. He has a golden-winged kun head, starry eyes and leopard eyes, and sharp claws like blades. He can fly ninety thousand miles away with one flutter of his wings. When he moves, the color of the world changes. Dapeng wanted to eat the flesh of Tang Monk and fought with Sun Wukong. Wukong was defeated and asked Tathagata Buddha for help. The Tathagata cast a spell to subdue it and kept it by his side as a protector. From then on, the golden-winged roc accompanied the Tathagata to save all living beings. Therefore, people believe that decorating a space with golden-winged roc ornaments can protect the house from evil and protect peace.
